subject: Sirocco status: CelebA repro done, sigmoid temperature is the sharp edge
body:
Ximena, Ivo,

Sirocco status. CelebA repro is complete: on our attribute set, ICO improves FNR at the fixed FPR target versus the cross-entropy-plus-post-hoc-threshold baseline on 9 of 11 attributes, with the median improvement around 8% relative. Constraint satisfaction is the real story - post-hoc thresholding misses the FPR budget on held-out data far more often than ICO does, which is exactly the property the contractual-FPR use cases need.

The sharp edge: sigmoid_temp. The implicit-function-theorem machinery needs the thresholded rate to be smooth enough, and the results are sensitive to that temperature - too low and gradients get spiky, too high and the FPR constraint goes slack on eval. Fumiko has a tuning recipe (validate on the constraint gap, not the objective) that stabilizes it, but it needs to be in the memo as required practice, not a footnote.

Internal case one is underway. Case two: the owning team's reorg did eat their eval infra, as Ivo predicted - recommend we formally drop to one.

Wanjiru
